entities.summary: Jari Jukka Hannu Koskela is a Finnish politician currently serving in the Parliament of Finland for the Finns Party at the Satakunta constituency. He is a Pastor and Doctor of Social Science. Jari Koskela was a religious figures from Kankaanpää (b. 1956-03-11, Kankaanpää). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
